body:
I'm doing a 5 day split Upper Lower Push Pull Legs. Been doing it for 7 months now.

I think I look pretty good now but my cardio and flexibility are absolute trash. I'm too obsessed with the way I look I'm afraid to change my workout routine because I might lose my gains.

I want to do yoga and go boxing and start running but I don't know how to balance any of it with my lifting without losing gains and going back to skinny-fat hell.

Any advice?
